messages:
ana: quick flag — deploybot reports a compatibility delta: runtime 2.19 shows KV pointer shift with quant-v5b in ap-southeast-1 on >4k tokens. recommend regional hold + float fallback.
deploybot: NOTICE: compatibility-check failure for model 'quant-v5b' vs runtime '2.19' in ap-southeast-1. Suggested action: region hold to runtime:2.18. Rate: 3.2% on longseq tests.
umar: can someone paste the minimal repro or failing logs? want to know if this is kernel or model-state corruption.
lina: log snippet from harness:
```
[2026-04-02T08:22:11Z] runtime-2.19 kernelX: kvcache ptr_shift mismatch shard=2 expected=4097 got=4077
[2026-04-02T08:22:11Z] model quant-v5b: attention_state checksum failed
```
eng-runtime: assigning runtime team to investigate. early hypothesis: GC windowing + async eviction race with quant kernels.
release-mgr: suggest regional pin via deploybot. keep TTL 18h to cover multiple timezones for triage.
nana: (typo) ignore.
deploybot: EXECUTE: pin add --scope region --region ap-southeast-1 --target runtime:2.18 --model quant-v5b --reason "kv ptr_shift longseq" --ttl 18h --mode soft
deploybot: Pin applied -> pin_id=pin_4491234567. Routing prefers runtime 2.18 for quant-v5b in ap-southeast-1 for new sessions. TTL=18h.
sre-oncall: added alerts: ap-southeast-1 quant-v5b errors >1% for 5m -> pager. Note: routing to float-fallback increases 95p latency ~60ms; tracking cost impact.
lina: i'll warm a float-compat pool and prepare autoscale rules. ETA ~20m.
eng-runtime: will run deterministic longseq harness, instrument eviction traces, and open a PR if repro is stable. ETA ~3h.
release-mgr: drafting changelog note: "ap-southeast-1: temporary routing to float variant for quant-v5b due to long-sequence KV alignment issue; regional hold applied." will post for review if we extend TTL.
nana: keeping this thread as SOT for the event. update here with repro/PR IDs or if metrics spike. :white_check_mark:
